items.t: UNIST-한수원, '에너지×AI 융합 연구혁신센터' 가동
items.d: UNIST(총장 박종래)와 한국수력원자력(이하 한수원)은 3일 UNIST에서 '에너지×인공지능(AI) 융합 연구혁신센터' 현판식을 열고 공동 연구에 본격 나섰다. 공동 연구 분야는 △AI 기반 원전 운영 최적화 및 안전성 향상 △발전소 자동화 및 에너지·수소 통합운영 △AI 융합기술의 응용 분야 확장 등이다. 공동 연구에는 원자력공학과, 인공지능대학원, 탄소중립대학원, U미래전략원 등 UNIST 주요 연구 조직이 참여한다. KAIST, 미래와도
items.fullText: 전국 UNIST-한수원, '에너지×AI 융합 연구혁신센터' 가동 발행일 : 2026-11-03 14:08 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 원전 운영·안전부터 자동화까지 AI 접목 연구 현장 수요 기반 7개 핵심과제 추진 UNIST(총장 박종래)와 한국수력원자력(이하 한수원)은 3일 UNIST에서 '에너지×인공지능(AI) 융합 연구혁신센터' 현판식을 열고 공동 연구에 본격 나섰다. 공동 연구 분야는 △AI 기반 원전 운영 최적화 및 안전성 향상 △발전소 자동화 및 에너지·수소 통합운영 △AI 융합기술의 응용 분야 확장 등이다. 공동 연구에는 원자력공학과, 인공지능대학원, 탄소중립대학원, U미래전략원 등 UNIST 주요 연구 조직이 참여한다. KAIST, 미래와도전 등도 공동 연구기관으로 함께 한다. 현판식에 앞서 '에너지×AI 융합 연구혁신센터'는 한수원 현장 수요와 AI 융합기술의 활용 가능성을 바탕으로 6개 핵심 연구과제와 단기 기술실증을 위한 퀵윈(Quick-Win, 즉각적 성과) 과제를 선정해 추진해왔다. 양 기관은 이번 현판식을 계기로 공동연구 성과의 현장 적용을 추진하고 기술 수요에 맞춰 새로운 과제를 도출할 계획이다. 박종래 총장은 “한수원과 협력은 대학 연구성과를 실제 에너지 산업 현장에 접목하는 중요한 산학협력 모델”이라며 “AI와 원자력·에너지 분야 융합으로 국가 에너지산업의 안전성과 경쟁력을 높이는 실질적 연구성과를 도출하겠다”고 말했다. 이광훈 한수원 품질기술본부장은 “에너지 산업 AI 전환은 현장에 대한 이해와 첨단 연구역량의 결합이 중요하다. UNIST와 공동연구로 현장 적용 혁신기술을 지속적으로 발굴하겠다”고 전했다. 울산=임동식 기자 dslim@etnews.com

items.t: SpaceX reportedly wants to buy Boost Mobile to compete with AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon
items.d: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.
items.fullText: SpaceX is looking to buy Boost Mobile from EchoStar, according to a report from The Washington Post. If the deal goes through, it would help the Elon Musk-owned company build a hybrid cellular-satellite network that could help catapult it into fourth place among the top U.S. wireless providers. The space-launch company has been dabbling in cellular connectivity, rolling out satellite access to T-Mobile’s subscribers in 2024. Last year, SpaceX bought $17 billion worth of wireless spectrum from EchoStar for cellular services, which could help the company’s Starlink service reach inside buildings, for example, something it currently struggles with. “This is the last critical piece of the spectrum puzzle needed for SpaceX to provide complete phone coverage in America,” Musk said on X at the time of the spectrum acquisition. Yet, if Musk is still looking to buy access to terrestrial networks, it apparently wasn’t the last piece. Elon Musk, SpaceX’s CEO, reportedly spoke directly with EchoStar chairman Charlie Ergen in October about acquiring Boost Mobile, the mobile virtual network operator. EchoStar has about 7.5 million customers between Boost Mobile and Gen Mobile, its other mobile service offering. Musk has also approached AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon about buying capacity on their networks. All three rejected Musk, and they may still have a say in a SpaceX acquisition of Boost Mobile. Boost doesn’t operate its own towers, instead leasing capacity from AT&T and T-Mobile, which might need to approve such a deal. Sources speaking to The Post said that network leases are usually nontransferable. The big three providers each have over 100 million subscribers, dwarfing Boost Mobile. But while the acquisition would give SpaceX an immediate bump in subscribers, the true value of the deal would be giving the company access to terrestrial cellular networks. items.t: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
items.d: Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 8:23 AM PST · November 2, 2026 Image Credits: Jonathan Raa/NurPhoto / Getty Images Amanda Silberling Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs Over Halloween weekend, some Grok Bot users awoke to something especially spooky: Their weekly usage limits were unexpectedly maxed out, even if they hadn’t been using SpaceX’s agentic AI overnight. Some users reported on X that their usage jumped from as low as 50% to 100% . SpaceX CEO Elon Musk confirmed in an X post on Sunday that this was not a glitch. “The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue,” he wrote in a reply to a question from a user. He has not addressed the issue on his main feed but has continued boasting that Grok Bot can help you buy gifts for your family. The cost of serving Grok Bot was unsustainably high relative to revenue — Elon Musk (@elonmusk) November 1, 2026 Grok Bot has been positioned as a success story for the newly public SpaceX, which said in a filing last month that AI now makes up 52% of company income. Its renamed “Super Intelligence” division actually turned a profit of $431 million, which is a rarity in the AI industry. Its profit would’ve been higher if not for $1.2 billion of one-time costs related to its acquisition of Cursor . Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having “the fastest growth of a product that I’ve ever seen in my life.” Musk has not yet shared how subscribers’ usage limits will be impacted moving forward.
